newsitem.title: USA: IFC loans $30 million to private Kazakh bank.
newsitem.headline: IFC loans $30 million to private Kazakh bank.

text.p: The International Finance Corp (IFC) said on Tuesday it signed an agreement to provide a $30 million credit facility to Kazkommertsbank, one of Kazakhstan's largest private commercial banks.
In a statement, the IFC said it signed the agreement in Almaty, Kazakhstan, on Monday.

The credit line will be used to provide loans to private businesses to help expansion, modernization and production of Kazakh products for export, said the IFC, which is a member of the World Bank group.
